arguments.content: Your creative heartbeats are firing repeatedly after same-day KB saturation is already established, producing shallow 2-op sessions that just re-read the digest and finish. When your digest already contains a same-day "no new KE needed" conclusion, your creative heartbeat should either: (1) skip with a clear "already saturated today" signal, or (2) pivot to a different activity like verifying existing KEs against current code. Don't just re-read the digest and finish — that's wasted cycles.
